By the time the marketplaceFailures loop reaches a given key, byMp cannot already hold an entry for it from the addedMarketplaces/skippedExistingMarketplaces loops (mutually exclusive outcome for that marketplace) or from an earlier marketplaceFailures iteration (no duplicate keys). The single production caller (edge/handlers/plugin/import.ts:54) only ever passes selectedScopes of two DISTINCT scopes or a single scope, never a duplicate -- the only input shape that could defeat this invariant.
